title: imap/session: idle_timeout_secs config is never enforced
description: crates/imap/src/config.rs defines idle_timeout_secs (default 1800s / 30min, per RFC 3501 §5.4) but crates/imap/src/session/mod.rs never enforces it — there is no tokio::time::timeout wrapping the read loop. An idle client holds a connection indefinitely. This wastes fd/memory and violates RFC 3501 §5.4. Fix: wrap the command-receive future in tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(config.limits.idle_timeout_secs), ...) and send untagged BYE on expiry.
